author: Liquidscribing
quote: This game deserves a 0 not because they literally created such a wrench **** but because this game is an actual attack on the GTA fan and gamers in general. GTA VI is gaslighting us to think that bland characters, uninspired humorless writing, outdated mechanics and poor performance are the pinnacle of gaming. It’s a humiliation ritual for the player and the customer. The game is incredibly realistic alright; it really lays bare the rot that is spreading through society.
